drugs.name: Nintedanib
drugs.mechanism: Intracellular tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting PDGF, FGF, and VEGF receptors to halt fibroblast proliferation and ECM deposition
drugs.efficacy: Significantly slows the annual rate of decline in forced vital capacity (FVC) in SSc-ILD
drugs.adverse_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, elevated liver transaminases, weight loss

drugs.name: Tocilizumab
drugs.mechanism: Recombinant humanized monoclonal antibody antagonizing soluble and membrane-bound IL-6 receptors
drugs.efficacy: Preserves lung function and prevents progressive fibrosis in early diffuse SSc-ILD
drugs.adverse_effects: Upper respiratory infections, neutropenia, elevated transaminases, injection reactions

drugs.name: Mycophenolate Mofetil
drugs.mechanism: Inhibitor of inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase selectively suppressing T and B lymphocyte proliferation
drugs.efficacy: First-line disease-modifying agent for cutaneous involvement and lung disease stabilization
drugs.adverse_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, leukopenia, opportunistic infections, teratogenicity

drugs.name: Bosentan
drugs.mechanism: Dual endothelin receptor A and B antagonist reversing vasoconstriction and vascular remodeling
drugs.efficacy: Prevents recurrence of new digital ischemic ulcers and improves exercise capacity in SSc-PAH
drugs.adverse_effects: Elevated liver transaminases, peripheral edema, headache, anemia, teratogenicity
